messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: extract error variance of items
parts: How to extract error variance of items from lavaan output?

See ?lavInspect for available options, also class?lavaan for other methods.  There are numerous ways, depending on your preferred format.

lavInspect(fit, "theta")
lavInspect(fit, "est")$theta # assuming a single-group/level
# included among other parameters:
coef(fit) 
parTable(fit)
